scope.operation: Conservatively classify inconsistent rooted ACIS projection snapshots as having known gaps when retained lump, shell, or face owner identities disagree with their parent/index rows.
invariants: typed lump rows are strictly source-index ordered and match the body's parsed lump-owner index
every retained lump's bodyNodeIndex equals the selected body root
typed shell rows are strictly source-index ordered and each shell's lumpNodeIndex resolves to a retained lump whose validated shell-owner index contains that shell
each face's shellNodeIndex resolves to a retained shell whose validated face-owner index contains that face
scope.semanticLimit: Projection snapshot consistency only; not source-record completeness, B-rep validity, native ACIS semantics, or consumer acceptance.
